Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.goals

Class GoalSelector

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.goals.GoalSelector
public class GoalSelector extends Object
Manages an ordered set of MannequinGoals for a single phase (normal or target) of a MannequinBrain.

Key-aware API (persistence)

Use addGoal(int, GoalKey, MannequinGoal) when the goal should survive restarts. The selector remembers the key and priority so the BrainRegistry can serialise them to PDC via serializeEntries().

Tick contract

Each tick, goals are evaluated in ascending priority order:
  1. Running goals whose MannequinGoal.canContinueToUse(Mannequin) returns false are stopped.
  2. Goals that are not running and whose MannequinGoal.canUse(Mannequin) returns true are started.

      public void addGoal(int priority, MannequinGoal goal)
      Adds a goal without a key. This goal will not be persisted to PDC and cannot be looked up or removed by key.

    • addGoal

      public void addGoal(int priority, GoalKey key, MannequinGoal goal)
      Adds a goal associated with a GoalKey. The key and priority are recorded so they can be serialised to PDC by the BrainRegistry.

      If a goal with the same key already exists it is replaced.

      Parameters:
      priority - lower value = higher priority
      key - stable identifier for this goal
      goal - the goal to add

    • removeGoal

      public boolean removeGoal(GoalKey key, org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Removes the goal registered under key, stopping it first if running.
      Parameters:
      key - the key of the goal to remove
      mannequin - the mannequin (needed to call MannequinGoal.stop(Mannequin))

      public boolean removeGoal(GoalKey key)

    • serializeEntries

      public String[] serializeEntries()
      Returns a snapshot of all keyed goal entries serialised as "priority:namespace:name" strings, ready to be written to PDC.

      Anonymous goals (added without a key) are omitted — they cannot be reconstructed and are expected to be transient.

      Returns:
      array of serialised entries; empty if no keyed goals are registered
